name: comp-267
blurb: Inline warning alert with amber icon.
description: Minimal inline alert displaying a warning message with an amber triangle icon from lucide-react. No dismiss action; purely informational.
use_when: Showing non-critical warnings inline with content, such as form validation hints or status messages.
avoid_when: Critical warnings that require user action. Dense layouts where space is limited.
a11y: No ARIA alert role. Icon is hidden from screen readers. Parent should add role='alert' and aria-live if needed.
